fullPassage: One of the main obstacles in anyone's quest for longevity is the fact that the skills that my colleagues and I acquired during our medical training have proved to be far more effective against fast death than slow death. We learned to fix broken bones, wipe out infections with powerful antibiotics, support and even replace damaged organs, and decompress serious spine or brain injuries. We had an amazing ability to save lives and restore full function to broken bodies, even reviving patients who were nearly dead. But we were markedly less successful at helping our patients with chronic conditions, such as cancer, cardiovascular disease, or neurological disease, evade slow death. We could relieve their symptoms and often delay the end slightly, but it didn't seem as if we could reset the clock the way we could with acute problems. We had become better at catching the eggs, but we had little ability to stop them from falling off the building in the first place.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

The skills acquired during medical training proved (A)[more / less] effective against fast death. We had an amazing ability to (B)[save / end] lives and restore function. But we were markedly (C)[less / more] successful at helping patients with chronic conditions.

det.korean: 급성 사망에는 '더(more)' 효과적이었고, 생명을 '구하는(save)' 능력이 있었으나, 만성 질환에는 '덜(less)' 성공적이었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① more - save - less: 급성 치료 강함, 만성 치료 약함의 대조
❌ ② more - end: end lives(생명을 끝내다)는 반대 의미
❌ ③ less - save: 급성 치료에 less effective는 원문과 반대
❌ ④ less - end: 두 가지 오류 동시 포함
det.tip: far more effective against fast death + markedly less successful at chronic conditions = 대조 구조

det.korean: acute(급성의, 갑작스러운) ↔ chronic(만성의, 장기적인). 글에서도 대조되어 사용됨.

✅ ① chronic: 만성의 — acute(급성)의 반의어. 글에서 직접 대조됨

❌ ③ replace: 교체하다 — 적절
det.tip: decompress = 압박을 풀다(척추/뇌 수술에서). cause와는 완전 반대.

❌ ③ avoid: 피하다 — evade의 유의어
❌ ④ flee: 도망가다 — evade의 유의어
det.tip: evade = avoid = escape ↔ confront = face

✅ ① obstacle - treating - relieve: 글의 논지와 정확히 일치
